title: Prioritizing Iterations
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting prioritizing iterations to capstone defense evidence board with limitations and transfer claims, social annotation signals, and adaptive learner-model evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze a capstone defense evidence board with limitations and transfer claims as evidence of learner judgment in AIL 606.
